subject: GFTIs
question: What does GFTI stand for in JoSAA counseling?
options: Government Funded Technical Institute, participating in centralized admission using JEE Main ranks
General Foreign Tuition Institute, requiring international visas only
Global Financial Training Initiative, offering only MBA finance degrees
Guaranteed Faculty Teaching License for primary schools

explanation.why: GFTIs (Government Funded Technical Institutes) are central/state government-supported engineering colleges that participate alongside NITs and IIITs in JoSAA/CSAB using JEE Main ranks.
explanation.shortcut: GFTI = Government Funded Technical Institute -> JEE Main + JoSAA.
explanation.commonTrap: Many good GFTIs remain overlooked by students—they join NITs and IIITs on the same JoSAA portal.
